description: This PHP source file defines the `ChannelStoriesApiController` class, which handles API actions related to channel stories in the Goteo project. It includes methods for validating node stories and updating their sort order, with permission checks and exception handling.

classes.name: ChannelStoriesApiController
classes.description: API controller class for managing channel stories, including validation and sorting of node stories.

methods.name: validateNodeStory
methods.description: Validates whether a node story exists and whether the user has permission to access it.

methods.name: nodestoriesSortAction
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to reorder a node story's position within a channel, with permission checks and error handling.
